ambassadors.name: Margaret Ko
ambassadors.funFact: Swam her first masters race at 41 — now holds three Japanese national age-group records.
ambassadors.perthPick: Sunrise laps at Cottesloe, coffee in Fremantle after.
ambassadors.quote: Kansai 2027 was the best two weeks of my life. Perth is where I'll defend my title — and I'm bringing twelve clubmates.
ambassadors.story: Margaret rediscovered swimming after her kids left home. Within five years she was on the blocks at the World Masters Games. Her club in Osaka now trains specifically for Perth 2029.

ambassadors.name: Dave Okafor
ambassadors.imgAlt: Sprinter in starting position on a track
ambassadors.funFact: Ran 11.2s for 100m at 45 — faster than he ran at 25.
ambassadors.perthPick: Kings Park at golden hour. I've seen the photos. I need to be in one.
ambassadors.quote: Masters athletics gave me back the athlete I thought I'd retired. Perth in October? Perfect sprint weather.
ambassadors.story: A former county-level sprinter, Dave came back to the track at 40 after a 15-year break. He now anchors his club's 4x100m relay and mentors first-time masters athletes.

ambassadors.name: Sue Tan
ambassadors.funFact: Plays five nights a week and captains three different club teams.
ambassadors.perthPick: Rottnest Island. A quokka selfie is non-negotiable.
ambassadors.quote: In Singapore we say badminton is for life. Perth 2029 is five hours away — our whole league is talking about it.
ambassadors.story: Sue organised a 22-player contingent to the Pan Pacific Masters Games. For Perth she's aiming for fifty.

ambassadors.name: Hannah Richter
ambassadors.imgAlt: Cyclist in racing kit with road bike
ambassadors.funFact: Has ridden a gran fondo in 14 countries. Australia will be number 15.
ambassadors.perthPick: The Swan Valley vineyards — by bike, naturally.
ambassadors.quote: German masters cycling is enormous, but we race the same roads every year. A world title race on the other side of the world? That's why you keep training.
ambassadors.story: Hannah leads a 60-strong women's cycling collective in Bavaria and is planning a three-week WA trip around the Games — racing first, Margaret River after.

ambassadors.name: Tom Parata
ambassadors.imgAlt: Rugby player holding a ball under his arm
ambassadors.funFact: Has played in six golden oldies festivals — and won the 'best third half' award at three.
ambassadors.perthPick: A west-coast sunset over the Indian Ocean. We don't get those at home.
ambassadors.quote: Masters rugby is the only sport where the after-match is a podium event. See you in Perth.
ambassadors.story: Tom's Wellington side has toured together for twenty years. Perth 2029 is pencilled in as the trip that brings the old squad back together — partners included.

ambassadors.name: Grace Mwangi
ambassadors.funFact: Runs the Perth foreshore every Saturday with a 200-member social running crew.
ambassadors.perthPick: My home course IS the Games course. I run the bridges loop every week.
ambassadors.quote: 30,000 athletes are about to discover what we locals already know — October in Perth is magic.
ambassadors.story: Grace founded one of Perth's biggest social running groups. She's leading the local charge: her goal is 500 WA runners on the half marathon start line.

ambassadors.name: Ken Yamada
ambassadors.imgAlt: Golfer watching a drive down the fairway
ambassadors.funFact: Has played golf on his birthday for 41 consecutive years.
ambassadors.perthPick: A round at sunrise, fish and chips in Fremantle at sunset.
ambassadors.quote: They tell me Perth has sandbelt courses and no winter. I have already told my wife we are going.
ambassadors.story: Ken competed at Kansai 2027 with three lifelong friends. They made a pact at the closing ceremony: next stop, Perth.

ambassadors.name: Maria Rossi
ambassadors.funFact: Her club team has played together since high school — 30 years and counting.
ambassadors.perthPick: Wine tasting in Margaret River. For research purposes.
ambassadors.quote: We play for the third set, the team dinner and the stories. Perth gives us the best version of all three.
ambassadors.story: Maria's Torino-based team went to the 2013 World Masters Games in their home city. Perth 2029 is the reunion tour.

ambassadors.name: Pete Jacobs
ambassadors.funFact: Took up bowls at 60 'temporarily'. Twelve years later he practises daily.
ambassadors.perthPick: The Games Village. I'm told there's live music every night — I'll be there.
ambassadors.quote: People ask when I'll slow down. I tell them: after Perth.
ambassadors.story: Pete has competed at every Australian Masters Games since 2017. Perth 2029 will be his first world Games — and his 73rd birthday falls on finals day.

ambassadors.name: Lena Novak
ambassadors.funFact: Qualified for masters racing the day she turned 30 — and hasn't missed a season since.
ambassadors.perthPick: An open-water swim at Cottesloe before the race even starts.
ambassadors.quote: A world masters tri on a closed course at a regatta centre, then two weeks exploring WA? Booked. Mentally, at least.
ambassadors.story: Lena races with USMS and USA Triathlon. She's building a Perth 2029 training squad from her Denver masters swim lane.
